injuries.name: Giannis Antetokounmpo
injuries.short_comment: Antetokounmpo (groin) is questionable for Wednesday's game in Philadelphia.
injuries.long_comment: Antetokounmpo missed Sunday's 123-113 win over the Thunder due to right groin tendinitis, but he was able to get through most of Tuesday's practice, so he's trending in the right direction. If he's cleared to return, Bobby Portis would likely head back to the second unit.

injuries.name: Joel Embiid
injuries.short_comment: Embiid (illness) is listed as doubtful for Wednesday's game versus Miami.
injuries.long_comment: Embiid missed Monday's 128-111 loss to Portland and doesn't appear to be on track to return Wednesday against the Heat. As a result, Jabari Walker could make another start, with more minutes available for Adem Bona and Dominick Barlow.

injuries.name: Ariel Hukporti
injuries.short_comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
injuries.long_comment: Hukporti went down with an Achilles injury in Monday's preseason opener against the Knicks, and an MRI has since revealed a rupture. He signed a one-year deal with the 76ers over the summer, so Hukporti will be an unrestricted free agent come season's end. With Hukporti's year already finished, Adem Bona (foot) should assume the backup center role behind Joel Embiid once healthy.

injuries.name: Giannis Antetokounmpo
injuries.short_comment: Antetokounmpo (groin) has been upgraded to probable for Wednesday's game against the 76ers.
injuries.long_comment: Antetokounmpo is trending toward returning from a one-game absence due to a right groin injury. The superstar's return would likely force Bobby Portis back to the bench. Over his last five appearances, Antetokounmpo has averaged 29.6 points, 12.2 rebounds, 5.8 assists and 2.2 combined steals-plus-blocks in 30.8 minutes per tilt.

injuries.name: Joel Embiid
injuries.short_comment: Embiid (illness) is out for Wednesday's game against Miami, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
injuries.long_comment: With Embiid set to miss a second straight game due to illness after previously being listed as doubtful, Philadelphia will again need to cover his vacated minutes at center. His absence removes one of the 76ers' top offensive options and should leave added frontcourt work available to the likes of Jabari Walker, Dominick Barlow and Adem Bona.
